reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_name, a.list_price_eur, s.product_name AS sister_name, b.list_price_eur AS sister_price_eur
FROM products p
JOIN products s ON s.product_id = p.sister_product_id
JOIN price_history a ON a.product_id = p.product_id AND DATE '2025-03-01' >= a.valid_from AND (a.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2025-03-01' <= a.valid_to)
JOIN price_history b ON b.product_id = s.product_id AND DATE '2025-03-01' >= b.valid_from AND (b.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2025-03-01' <= b.valid_to)
WHERE a.list_price_eur < b.list_price_eur
alternatives: SELECT p.product_name, a.list_price_eur, s.product_name AS sister_name, b.list_price_eur AS sister_price_eur FROM products p JOIN products s ON s.product_id = p.sister_product_id JOIN price_history a ON a.product_id = p.product_id AND DATE '2025-03-01' BETWEEN a.valid_from AND COALESCE(a.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31') JOIN price_history b ON b.product_id = s.product_id AND DATE '2025-03-01' BETWEEN b.valid_from AND COALESCE(b.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31') WHERE a.list_price_eur < b.list_price_eur

WITH day_price AS (SELECT product_id, list_price_eur FROM price_history WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2025-03-01' AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2025-03-01')) SELECT p.product_name, a.list_price_eur, s.product_name AS sister_name, b.list_price_eur AS sister_price_eur FROM products p JOIN products s ON s.product_id = p.sister_product_id JOIN day_price a ON a.product_id = p.product_id JOIN day_price b ON b.product_id = s.product_id WHERE a.list_price_eur < b.list_price_eur

other_way.sql: WITH day_price AS (SELECT product_id, list_price_eur FROM price_history WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2025-03-01' AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2025-03-01')) SELECT p.product_name, a.list_price_eur, s.product_name AS sister_name, b.list_price_eur AS sister_price_eur FROM products p JOIN products s ON s.product_id = p.sister_product_id JOIN day_price a ON a.product_id = p.product_id JOIN day_price b ON b.product_id = s.product_id WHERE a.list_price_eur < b.list_price_eur
other_way.tradeoff: A CTE of each product's price on the day is used for both sides, so the range test is written once instead of twice.

solver.query:
SELECT p.product_name, hp.list_price_eur, s.product_name AS sister_name, hs.list_price_eur AS sister_price_eur
FROM products p
JOIN products s ON s.product_id = p.sister_product_id
JOIN price_history hp ON hp.product_id = p.product_id
  AND hp.valid_from <= DATE '2025-03-01' AND (hp.valid_to IS NULL OR hp.valid_to >= DATE '2025-03-01')
JOIN price_history hs ON hs.product_id = s.product_id
  AND hs.valid_from <= DATE '2025-03-01' AND (hs.valid_to IS NULL OR hs.valid_to >= DATE '2025-03-01')
WHERE hp.list_price_eur < hs.list_price_eur
